en: Colorized vintage view of a European riverside city. In the foreground there is a riverside path with a wooden railing running beside a calm river and an iron bridge. On the opposite bank stands a row of elegant multi‑storey historicist buildings and a church tower with a dome-like roof. Behind the city rises a steep hill topped by fortifications, and on the slope another prominent clock tower is visible. Printed text at the top right identifies the scene as being in Graz and mentions the Radetzky Bridge and the Schlossberg hill.
